description: Search the UK Environment Agency real-time river/tidal monitoring network for stations, filterable by town, river name, catchment name, measured parameter (level, flow, rainfall, wind, temperature), or freetext label search. Returns station_id, name, river/catchment, coordinates, and the measures each station records — use station_id with uk-ea-flood-monitoring.station_readings to get its latest values. Data: environment.data.gov.uk/flood-monitoring, UK Open Government Licence v3.0, no auth required.

catchment_name.description: Filter stations by river catchment name (e.g. "Cotswolds").

parameter.description: Filter stations by the type of measurement they record.

river_name.description: Filter stations by river name, partial match (e.g. "River Severn").

search.description: Freetext search matching the station label/name.

name: uk-ea-flood-monitoring.stations.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: UK Flood Monitoring Station Search
